raw_evidence_sections.heading: Admission requirements
raw_evidence_sections.text: The admissions process for the Master in Global Management is designed to identify candidates who will thrive in the program’s collaborative, international, and interdisciplinary environment. When evaluating applications, the Admissions Committee looks for the following qualities: A desire to drive positive change through business An international outlook, intercultural competency, and a responsible approach to business

raw_evidence_sections.heading: General requirements
raw_evidence_sections.text: A previous degree (at least Bachelor's equivalent) with excellent grades. If you are completing your undergraduate studies within the next year, your application will also be considered. Recently graduated, with no more than 24 months of postgraduate work experience (excluding internships) English language proficiency test scores (if applicable) Submitting an English proficiency test score (TOEFL, IELTS or TOEIC) is not mandatory. Your English language skills are also assessed in the selection interview. You will receive a waiver for the English proficiency test if English is your native language or if you have completed a university degree completely taught in English. If required, ESMT expects a minimum score of 100 in the TOEFL, 7.0 in the IELTS, or 850 in the TOEIC. The ESMT TOEFL institution code is 8707. Evidence of quantitative skills - depending on your profile, you may be required to take the BAT or GMAT/GRE test) GMAT or GRE scores are not obligatory if candidates can provide alternative evidence of quantitative skills or scientific training within their Bachelor studies through competitive grades, that included general quantitative courses or with a degree in engineering, natural sciences, mathematics, statistics, or another quantitative field (including economics or business with mainly theoretical/quantitative coursework). As a guideline, GMAT scores below 600 or GRE scores below 304 are not considered competitive. Depending on educational background and the grades, the review of scores can focus more on the quantitative section of the respective test. Candidates may also take the ESMT Business Admissions Test (BAT) or receive a waiver for the tests if their academic transcripts or related qualifications demonstrate sufficient quantitative skills.

raw_evidence_sections.heading: Additionally, you will be asked to submit the following documents with your application :
raw_evidence_sections.text: Your CV Academic transcripts from all higher education institutions you have attended One recommendation letter from a current or former employer, or a professor (a form template can be provided by ESMT if needed) GRE/GMAT and TOEFL scores, if needed

raw_evidence_sections.heading: ESMT cannot begin assessing your application until all of the required documents are received.
raw_evidence_sections.text: If you would like to join the Global Impact Program (GIP) in your second year, please indicate your interest in your application. Final confirmation will be required during your first months at ESMT. Please note that there are only 30 slots available for the Global Impact Program.

raw_evidence_sections.text: Following a thorough review of your application, you may be invited for a short interview with an ESMT administrator or professor. All interviews for the program will be conducted online via Zoom or at the ESMT campus in Berlin . You will also have the opportunity to to clarify open questions and provide deeper insights to your application.
